## What this is

FIX-PLAN §2 F0.5 acceptance: “Each gate, fed a deliberately broken tree,
goes red (prove it once in the PR).” For every F0.5 gate whose logic runs
without cargo: a throwaway copy of the repo (mktemp workdir, trimmed of
.git, the root audit/ evidence tree, design/ assets, target/ and
node_modules/ — no gate under proof reads any of them), exactly ONE
seeded break, the REAL gate script run inside the copy, the exit code
asserted. The real tree is never mutated (sentinel guard G0).

No cargo runs anywhere in this harness: gates that need an instrument
(cargo for mem-audit, cargo-fuzz for the campaign) run behind test shims
on the copy's PATH — the gate's own sampling, parsing, judging and exit
path execute for real; only the instrument is emulated. The behavioral
proofs that need the real instruments (clippy -D warnings, miri, asan,
ubsan) are parked below with their exact central commands.

### C1 — clippy -D warnings behavioral (from .github/workflows/rust-clippy.yml)

```
set -o pipefail
cargo clippy --all-features --message-format=json -- -D warnings \
  | clippy-sarif | tee rust-clippy-results.sarif | sarif-fmt
```

Central proof: seed a deliberate clippy warning (e.g. an unused import in
a throwaway crate), run the command above — clippy exits non-zero
(-D warnings turns the warning into an error), pipefail carries it through
the SARIF pipeline, the workflow step is red. G7 proved the wiring this
command depends on.
